card.title: How To Fix iPhone 8 With No Touch

source.title: How To Fix iPhone 8 With No Touch

claims.statement: iPhone 8 no touch is usually pry damage near LCD connector J5700 to FL5776, FL5762 or R5772; trace the OL/short along the touch line.
If readings are normal, bend out the four connector ground pins or replace the connector.

procedure: Bend out ground pins on LCD and home button connectors.
Replace the LCD connector if needed.
card.caveats: Source lists 'RR5772', read here as R5772. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
